token_id.description: Unique identifier for this delegation token

delegator.description: Agent ID or public key of the delegating party

delegate.description: Agent ID of the party receiving delegation

delegate_public_key.description: Ed25519 public key of the delegate

capabilities.description: List of authorized capabilities or scopes

reversibility_tier.description: Tier of operations permitted (e.g., READ_ONLY, REVERSIBLE, IRREVERSIBLE)

limits.description: Quantitative limits (e.g., rate limits, value limits)

intent_hash.description: Cryptographic hash of the user intent or execution context

signature.description: Ed25519 signature by the delegator over the JCS-canonicalized token payload
